blocks.text: All-in-one workspace that unifies docs, databases, and project management

Notion has become the default operating system for startups, and for good reason. It replaces a half-dozen tools - docs, wikis, project trackers, databases, meeting notes - with a single flexible workspace. When your team is small and every dollar counts, that consolidation is transformative.

The database system is Notion's secret weapon. A single database can render as a table, board, timeline, calendar, or gallery - adapting to how each team member thinks. Product teams see a Kanban board, while leadership sees a roadmap timeline, all powered by the same underlying data.

Notion's AI features add another layer of utility. Summarize meeting notes, draft product specs, translate content, or extract action items - all within the tool where your team already works. No context switching required.
Build custom systems with tables, boards, timelines, calendars, and galleries
Summarize, draft, translate, and extract insights with built-in AI
Team knowledge base with nested pages, templates, and search
Connect with Slack, GitHub, Figma, and 100+ tools via API
Thousands of community templates for every use case
Real-time editing, comments, mentions, and permission controls

Nearly every startup we work with uses Notion as their knowledge base and project hub. Its flexibility means it grows with you - what starts as a simple doc repository evolves into a full company operating system.
Our team can integrate Notion into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
